description.value: The Wine Cellar is a liquor and wine retail shop located within the village at Big White Ski Resort, one of Canada's largest ski resorts situated above Kelowna in the Okanagan. It forms part of a combined market and liquor operation serving resort guests and visitors year-round when the resort is open. Cyclists passing through or staying at Big White can stock up on wine and spirits here during the summer operating season.
